title: Binding studies of sertraline hydrochloride with CT-DNA using experimental and computational techniques.
authors: Sharma, Palak; Gopi, Priyanka; Singh, Shweta; Rani, Majji Sai Sudha; Pandya, Prateek
journal: Spectrochimica acta. Part A, Molecular and biomolecular spectroscopy
one_liner_zh: 该文通过光谱实验、分子对接和MD模拟研究抗抑郁药STH与CT-DNA的小沟槽结合机制，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作（药物-DNA）且采用计算建模方法，但非TF-DNA体系，方法可迁移至TF-DNA界面研究。
abstract: Sertraline Hydrochloride (STH) is an antidepressant drug that belongs to the selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor family (SSRIs), which inhibits serotonin uptake in presynaptic nerve fibers. The use of these medications without a legitimate prescription might result in adverse effects, and in rare circumstances, death. The interaction mechanism and binding mode of STH with duplex DNA were extensively investigated using spectroscopic and modeling techniques at different temperatures. The hypochromic shift of the absorption spectra of STH on binding with CT-DNA indicated groove binding. Fluorescence spectroscopic studies showed that CT-DNA quenches the fluorescence intensity of STH through a static quenching mechanism. The thermodynamic parameters indicated that the complex formation was spontaneous, and enthalpy driven. The competitive displacement binding study revealed that STH displaced DAPI from the minor groove of DNA. Molecular docking and molecular dynamics simulations also revealed that the complex was stable over 150 ns and that STH preferred the minor groove of DNA. The binding energy of the stable conformations were evaluated through MM/PBSA methods. A comparison of the bound poses at different timescales showed minor changes in STH structure upon DNA binding. Furthermore, a structural analysis of CT-DNA indicated that STH induced changes in the sugar-phosphate backbone had an impact on the minor groove's width which are in agreement with the CD spectroscopic results. This study provides a better understanding of STH binding with duplex DNA.
abstract_zh: 盐酸舍曲林（Sertraline Hydrochloride, STH）是一种抗抑郁药物，属于选择性5-羟色胺再摄取抑制剂家族（SSRIs），其作用机制为抑制突触前神经纤维对5-羟色胺的再摄取。未经合法处方使用这些药物可能导致不良反应，在极少数情况下甚至会导致死亡。本研究采用光谱学和建模技术，在不同温度下深入探讨了STH与双链DNA的相互作用机制及结合模式。STH与CT-DNA结合时，其吸收光谱发生减色位移，表明存在沟槽结合。荧光光谱研究表明，CT-DNA通过静态猝灭机制降低STH的荧光强度。热力学参数显示复合物形成是自发的，且由焓驱动。竞争性置换结合研究揭示，STH能将DAPI从DNA的小沟中置换出来。分子对接和分子动力学模拟进一步表明，复合物在150纳秒内保持稳定，且STH优先结合DNA的小沟。通过MM/PBSA方法评估了稳定构象的结合能。不同时间尺度下结合姿态的比较显示，STH在与DNA结合后结构变化微小。此外，对CT-DNA的结构分析表明，STH诱导的糖-磷酸骨架变化影响了小沟宽度，这与圆二色谱（CD）光谱结果一致。本研究为深入理解STH与双链DNA的结合提供了更全面的认识。
